source_text: Randomized controlled trials (RCTs) conducted in sub-Saharan Africa demonstrate that adult male circumcision reduces heterosexual HIV acquisition by 50-60%, with three major trials (involving over 10,000 participants) showing sustained efficacy over 5-6 years of follow-up. [19]
